args.title: Fix issue 4424 in src/exportUtils.ts
args.body:
File: src/exportUtils.ts

The function formatExportFilename in src/exportUtils.ts uses at.toISOString().slice(0, 10) to format the date, which outputs the date in UTC rather than the local time zone. This causes exports performed in the evening in certain time zones to appear as the next day's date. To fix this, the function should format the date using the local time zone instead of UTC.

args.title: Fix issue 4434 in src/components/UploadForm.tsx
args.body:
File: src/components/UploadForm.tsx

In src/components/UploadForm.tsx, the upload error message is stored in state as 'problem' and displayed, but the message is only cleared (set to null) when a new upload is submitted (handleSubmit) and not when a new file is picked. The onChange handler for the file input only sets the file state but does not clear the problem state. To fix, modify the onChange handler to also clear the problem state immediately when the user picks a new file, so the old error message disappears right away.
